T: Hang your hammer on the hook. Dinner's up.
D: Thor teams up with his brother Loki to stop the Dark Elves from plunging the universe into darkness.
P: Serve the snacks when Thor hangs his hammer on the coat hook in Jane's flat.
S: Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in pork sausage meat with sage, crumbed and fried at 170C for 6 minutes, halved with English mustard.
Thor catching the Underground to Greenwich
Thick chips cooked twice, at 140C then 190C, served in paper with malt vinegar and plenty of salt.
Jane's awkward restaurant date before Thor turns up

Grilled ciabatta rubbed with garlic, piled with ripe tomato and basil, torn buffalo mozzarella, sea salt and a drizzle of good olive oil. Dice 500g ripe tomatoes and mix with a handful of torn basil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt, and leave 15 minutes. Slice 1 ciabatta into 12 pieces, brush with olive oil and grill or toast until charred at the edges. Rub each with a cut garlic clove. Pile on the tomato, tear over 2 balls of buffalo mozzarella and finish with sea salt and more oil.
M: Asgard honey and rosemary lamb shoulder
Frigga's home in the golden halls of Asgard

Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and honey, slow roasted until it pulls apart, with roasted root vegetables and the pan juices. Stab a 2kg lamb shoulder all over and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs. Rub with 3 tbsp honey, olive oil and salt. Put in a roasting dish with 250ml water, cover with foil and roast at 150C for 5 hours. Add 1kg chopped carrots, parsnips and potatoes for the last 90 minutes, uncovering for the final 30. Pull the lamb apart and spoon over the juices.
Thor fighting through the streets of Greenwich
Beef chuck and ale pie filling simmered 3 hours, under a puff pastry lid baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with mash and green peas.
W: Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with vanilla custard and topped with blackberries glazed in blackberry jam.
K: Aether blood orange and cranberry spritz
the red Aether flowing into Jane

Vodka shaken with blood orange and cranberry juice and lime, topped with soda over ice, swirling deep red like the Aether. For each drink, shake 30ml vodka, 60ml blood orange juice, 60ml cranberry juice and 10ml lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a wine glass full of ice and top with 60ml soda water. Garnish with a blood orange wheel and a rosemary sprig. Make four, using 120ml vodka in total. Leave out the vodka for a booze-free version.

s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Mix 400g pork sausage mince with chopped sage and wrap around each egg. Roll in flour, beaten egg and panko, then fry at 170C for 6 minutes. Halve and serve with English mustard.

s.note: Thor catching the Underground to Greenwich
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, rinse and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes until soft, then drain and rest. Fry again at 190C until golden and crisp. Tip into paper, shake over malt vinegar and plenty of sea salt flakes.

m.note: Thor fighting through the streets of Greenwich
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck with 2 sliced onions. Add 375ml brown ale and water to cover and simmer for 3 hours until tender. Thicken, pour into a dish and top with puff pastry. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with buttery mash and green peas.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case until golden and cool completely. Fill with 500ml thick vanilla custard and pile 250g blackberries on top. Warm blackberry jam with a splash of water and brush over the fruit to glaze. Dust the edge with icing sugar.
